remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS BY WEDS. 4/23 @ 5:00PM  Welcome to 36 Meadowpark Avenue East, an exquisitely expanded and completely redone residence, offering the perfect blend of elegance and modern convenience. This centrally located Stamford gem provides easy access to shopping, dining, the parkway, and the train, ensuring a lifestyle of comfort and accessibility.  Step inside to discover an expansive 3,690 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. The first floor features a luxurious primary suite, offering a private retreat with elegant finishes. The home boasts a total of five spacious bedrooms and three full bathrooms, each crafted with exceptional attention to detail. The house has been wired professionally for sound, both inside and out and the 2nd floor movie theater set up has Atmos sound. The heart of this residence is its inviting living areas, seamlessly flowing from room to room. The mud room, conveniently attached to the two-car garage, provides practical storage solutions with an elegant touch. The finished basement offers additional versatile space, perfect for entertaining or relaxation.  Step outside to your private oasis-a flat, fenced-in backyard ideal for outdoor gatherings. A charming terrace invites you to enjoy tranquil moments, while a hot tub provides the perfect spot for unwinding after a long day.  Set on a generous 10,019 square foot lot, this home is a true sanctuary, offering both elegant living and convenience.
